comments.comment: Thank you for sharing this is close to my heart ❤️
Im so glad you’ve brought this difficult conversation to others 👏

I tried to leave this earth twice after having one. I was so depressed I didn't move out of bed for months, it was awful for everyone around me but I was completely empty & numb. God bless my grandparents for taking care of me. I've found jesus now & beg forgiveness every other day.

I had a termination when I was 18 due to health reasons. It crushed me. I’ve never felt so empty and broken. And I’ve held onto that feeling ever since. Years later, I had my son, and then my daughter. I’ve never mentioned this to them. One day, I was walking my son to school (he was 5 and we had gone to church together maybe twice), and he asked me if I remembered when he was in my tummy before? I was confused and asked if he meant when he was a baby? Because that I’ll never forget. But he said “No, the time before. You and Daddy decided it wasn’t a good time to meet me yet, so I went back to Heaven to play with God. We used to watch you. But then you decided you were ready, and I came into your tummy again, and this time I got to meet you. I was so excited. I’m so lucky I got to have you as my Mummy.” It healed something in me that I didn’t realise could be fixed.

Thank you for being brave enough to share your story. I too had an abortion back in 2002. I’m going to be brief on this but you said something that made complete sense to me in this moment, yes it was the spirit of death..I’ve had three miscarriages and yes I and sharing that the heaviness and pain of the abortion still carries weight to this very day. I was never told that I might need heavy counselling. Or that I would feel deeply suicidal for a very long time, or about the awful nightmares or the fact for me personally I felt the pull of and eternity in hell. Despite not being a Christian at the time. Nor did I understand Gods forgiveness nor grace. I was deeply wounded. I can testify that I only healed once I knew I was saved by Christ, that His blood was shed on that cross for that very sin and for all my sins for that matter. I do still to this day think of my baby who I truly believe was a little girl and I named her years and years ago. I do not judge at all. But I am now deeply pro life. I went on to have four more children and I’d already had my eldest daugher prior to my abortion. Even with my kids when they were old enough to know about abortion through high school, I was always honest with them as to why I am deeply pro life. I would be raw and honest in the sense that this was my experience. So I could never be called a hypocrite. I also have to testify it was my abortion that brought me on my knees to Christ begging for His forgiveness. Then this man a dear old man who was a born again believer in Christ came into our lives through sheer chance, he gave me the Gospel and I confessed to him that I felt so unworthy of Christs love yet he told me that Gospel message. He never judged me, he asked me if I accepted the Gospel to which I and my husband did. We got saved in 2016. Married 8 weeks later. And still going strong. I am healed. I know my child is with the Lord and that I will see her again and my my miscarried children. I have hope. No more nightmares. Just peace. ❤️❤️

What a beautiful and important message. 1 in 4 women have an abortion by the age of 45. Their risk for suicide increases 600% after the abortion. This is an incredibly important conversation. I myself had an abortion, as well as a stillbirth about 10 years after... I know this pain deeply too. It's now my ministry to walk with women who are hurting due to similar trauma and loss. I see you doing that too, sister!🤍 Thank you.

I had a medical termination earlier this year. I did it out of fear and I lacked trust in God to make me a good mother. My partner and I were also facing financial struggles. It is a long, brutal process to go through and the isolation you feel afterwards is indescribable. The remorse is deeper than the deepest ocean and I think of them daily. I ask Jesus all the time to give them a hug from me and to let them know I love them still. I am now with child again and currently 6 weeks along. I am choosing to trust Jesus this time and to let His will be done. Through all the doubts and fear this time, I am choosing to lean on Him and His understanding, not my own. Thank you for sharing your story, Jess. God bless you, sister 🙏❤️

My friend got an abortion 10 years ago and still struggles to not self unalive herself because of it. If you got one and you feel this immense guilt, God forgives you and please forgive yourself 🙏🏼 and strive to help others choose life 🩷 be the change and love you needed

Ive had one. Was forced by my mother. Ive had 3 miscarriages from a abusive relationship. I never get over the grief. It kills me every year. You are right the spirit of death does haunt you. What's worse is the abortion industry is not honest about the trauma it leaves on the body. Now im 35, and having complications to even have children. The pain is so real. I forgave my abuser but it took a life time to forgive myself for going through with it. Praise God for sending Jesus for forgiveness would of never entered my heart. But the grief will last a life time. I love the saying that was going around last year. "When i die plz put me in sweat clothes with sneakers tied tight. I gotta play date in heaven with someone special." 🥹
Thank you for sharing this perspective. Catholic St. Faustina’s diary is all about the mercy of Jesus. It caused quite a stir in the Church among some. It’s powerful reading.

Thank you for being brave and bold to share this. This information is so incredibly important. Whether you decide on your own to make this decision or not, having the actual facts and knowledge is so IMPORTANT! I can’t even begin to imagine the confusion and uncertainty surrounding this situation and the effects that can come from it, but I am so grateful for you sharing this. 🙌 having the tough conversations is what we need to learn and grow. ❤️

If you’re thinking of terminating your pregnancy and came across this video, know that it’s not a coincidence. Jesus loves you so much that He wants to let you know that it’ll be ok. You can be set free through the sacrifice He made for you on the cross. He’s your father, and He will never leave you, nor forsake you.

Thank you! I think we need to talk more about the spiritual side of pregnancy and motherhood. I swear after having kids my ability to “know” what’s on my children mind and their fathers have increased. Their DNA is left in us creating a physical connection.

Eternal memory to all the little ones and may God bless and keep us who experienced loss and suffered under abortion.

Pregnancy is so spiritual! Midwives have believed so for a long, long time. I recently read and loved "Beyond Ourselves" by Catherine Marshall, she is such an old-school lady in the best way and her writing is so full of enthusiasm for the faith that it's contagious. She spends a chapter talking about one lady's testimony, a major part of which was a high-risk pregnancy preceeded by multiple losses. Her doctor actually told her, having no other explanation for her about her womb troubles, that a correlation had been found between pregnancy loss and feelings of guilt. Guilt during the pregnancy, not after. So the woman did all in her power, relying heavily on her church for support, to ground herself in her forgiven identity in Christ. Although she struggled with so much shame from her past, she was able to conquer it and her pregnancy was a healthy one. A beautiful real-life example and testimony from an excellent book. God bless you.

I've had one in 2019, its eating me up now that I've been saved and am trying to grow closer to God. I feel such immense pain from that decision that I don't think I will ever fully get over. I think about that baby all the time 😭 I strongly encourage anybody now to please choose life ❤️ you never know where your life will be in the future

Thank you, thank you, thank you for being so open and vulnerable and honest. I wish this kind of dialogue was more "allowed" on BOTH sides of this debate. You're doing well, sister. Praying for your strength and protection in this.

I had one too also due to health issues. I cried so much that they could barely give me the anesthesia. Even now when writing I’m crying. And it has been 13 years. I have asked Jesus for forgiveness, but still a part of me hurts. Thank you for bringing up the subject. I do think it is important. God bless 🙏🏼❤️
I'm so sorry Jess. ❤️ May Jesus wrap his loving arms around you and your babies! ❤️✝️ Jesus heals, and he loves you and your kiddos.

I feel so seen in this post. It was a termination that led me to Christianity. It was for medical reasons, but still it was the worst thing I’ve ever experienced and both I and my boyfriend (now husband) were spiritually attacked afterwards for a year. Our life was miserable, we broke up. He told me he felt a demon whispering in his ear, and I felt the same way. We are now married and expecting a healthy baby boy, and what a blessing to know I wasn’t crazy when I said I was deathly sick, and now have a positive and beautiful pregnancy experience. My heart aches for anyone who has been through this.
I don't ever expect to be forgiven 😢😢
I was forced to it 4 y ago. Since i feel depressed, grief every day, my life changed dramatically that I don't see purpouse being here. I would do anything to have that baby
I just want to give her a big hug telling her how proud I am for her speaking out. That was brave and needed to be talked about
It also makes your body high chance of having the miscariage when you want a baby

If anyone sees this post and is considering a medical abortion for a terminal diagnosis, I just want to offer you a different perspective. My baby was diagnosed very early with Trisomy 18...considered by many docs to be very terminal (I found out elsewhere that it's not 100% terminal). My baby's heart was irreparable. They offered abortion many times. I would be lying if I said that wasn't the worst year of my life (last year). But I knew that as long as he was in there, he was happy, loved, and safe. We made it full term and we got him 9 hrs. It is a certain agony to mourne a still-living child. I was removed. Weepy. My world shrunk to just what was around me. Yet, after it was all said and done, I feel God speak to me, reveal to me, redeem my grief. I am so much wiser by going through the storm, rather than try to go around it, if you will. If anyone needs help with a terminal diagnosis, please reach out. Termination is not your only option unfer most circumstances (not all). Tgere is so much beauty in carrying a terminal baby. There is a deep surrender that ypu can't control their little lives. And its ok to not put that choice in your hands.
Me too. We had the same sickness.the severe hyperemesis. When I was in hospital they told me I was the sickest they had ever seen. I completely understand your heart ache.
I have spiritual discernment. I 1000% believe that you probably did have the actual spirit of death on you. From what I’ve gathered, the spirit of death slowly tries to suck the life out of people.

You did better than me with this video.

I had three abortions. I made a few videos about abortion, though you know when there are other spirits speaking through you as well? One of them came across really judgemental.

I believe abortion should be abolished completely. It’s so wrong and our selfishness shouldn’t override a baby’s right to life. 😞😞

I had 2 ectopic pregnancies and had to have them surgically removed. While I know they would never have survived, and I could have died as well, I still grieve them. I had 4 more miscarriages then by the healing of Jesus, I had a daughter, then a son. I completely understand what you are saying. I felt guilt, death, and I dealt with severe depression.

The abortion industry is very dishonest with women about the ease of abortion. It is presented as a simple procedure that you can walk away from and never think about again. They present it this way, but leave women broken and hurting with a burden they carry the rest of their lives. Praise the Lord for His forgiveness and restoration! Thank you for being an honest voice to women on this subject.

This is how I know it is from the spirit. This is the issue. We never have a platform where you can speak as a woman about these things without obnoxious men yelling it is murder. You are very brave to speak up about this. The logic behind it messes with all women's brains if it is not for themselves it is their mom.
I feel the same way rn 😢

Thank you for sharing such a vulnerable topic with the audience. It takes courage to do so! I have had one miscarriage and it left me very empty and for sure opened a lot of spiritual doors for the enemy. Nevertheless, I just wanted to share with you that me and my husband has seen two testimonies now where both of the men who reached heaven witnessed that all of the miscarried and aborted babies are just forever baby in heaven, waiting for their parents to finally come and raise them together in heaven with Jesus 💜 First time I have heard it I have felt so much pressure in my chest and I burst into tears of joy . Only God is so good to think fo such an idea. We look forward to see our baby in heaven, and I wanted to leave this message for you as well 💜

My mom is still grieving the one she had before me. It's been 30something years. She had a valid reason in many people's view, didn't help the damage. I have a few friends who had them decades ago and are still healing, compensating the love and care they feel they should've had onto their living children. This is not a decision to be taken lightly, and definitely not for convenience

I saw a bumper sticker one time in the 1990s but I never forgot the message. “Abortion. No matter how bad you feel about yourself Jesus still lives you”. This is the Gospel of Grace and Truth testified in the Scripture revealed in a simple message that hopefully reached a few hearts. A few years later I felt called to stop at an abortion clinic to talk to a small group of protestors out front. They had the standard fare of signage calling abortion murder in a variety of ways. After thanking them for their devotion I asked them if they wanted a suggestion for a few signs. They very positively said they did. So I gave them the message from the bumper sticker along with this suggestion. “Father forgive them for they have no idea what they are doing.” No one said a word. I thanked them again and left them in silence.

I was raised by a mother who was extremely physically abusive to me and my other sister. Verbally abusive to me after I grew bigger and stronger through athleticism where I almost kicked her ass when she hit me once. I have her demons I know I do. So I had an abortion (42 years ago) because kids deserve love and support by a healthy mother. If I could change the past I would. This is very painful to admit. Praying for all my sisters here who had to deal with this.
Finally someone with the truth. So many friends who need to hear this.

Your openness and honesty about this situation is so appreciated. Thank you for talking about this. Its never so clear cut as the world puts it on either side. It is real. It is hard. And it definitely puts thoughts on your heart. Thank You God for forgiveness and love. I believe with abortion, women should seek counseling, if for nothing else, to speak their feelings! Holding on to this in secret would torment and open plenty of doors for negativity. Thanks Jess for talking this one out!!! May God bless all our hearts🙏

I can’t relate to how sad this is because I was never forced to make this choice but if there is any solace these souls are with Jesus. We have no idea what awaits us. We don’t know if there are other different quantum timelines we don’t know if Jesus assigns them a new role. No matter what, they are in the presence of God still fulfilling their destiny albeit in a different way. God bless all of you who suffer. God is good all the time and your babes are in His presence.
Thank you for sharing your experience- that must have been a bit scary to do. ❤️
Yes! Such a necessary conversation! 🙌❤️🙌
Thank you for sharing ❤️ this needs to be talked about more.
You will meet them in Heaven. They are not lost and I believe that Jesus forgave you ❤️
I’ve never had one but fully respect it is not cut and dry. Regardless Jesus still loves his ladies ❤️
Thankyou for talking about this, as so many of us are not. Your ministry is going to do what many have dropped. Thank you
Beautifully said.
Thank you for sharing this with us
